name: project-state
description: Turn any multi-stakeholder project into a system where routine reporting is a byproduct of normal work. 55 skills for milestones, objectives/KPIs, phase gates, document curation, status reports, defect/feedback registration to GitHub issues, funder/grant compliance, and a local kanban — driven by 10 swappable compliance packs (PIC, grant-Canada, board/investor, client-services, agile, open-source, plus one bundled with each capability) and 4 capability plugins (Canadian SR&ED with guided onboarding and T661 audit review; Tender — public-sector tender discovery, qualification and pursuit; Intel — a standing desk for the entities and signals around a project, with the competitive layer: claims, battlecards, deal briefs (OCI v0.1, L1); Portfolio — one Project that understands, queries and synthesizes a set of member projects).
